children: Move with w, a, s, d and type a digit. 0 clears a cell.
1. Every row, column and 3x3 box must hold 1 to 9 once. The bold digits are given; fill the rest.
2. Move the yellow cursor with w, a, s and d, then type a digit. 0 clears a cell. A digit that repeats in its row, column or box turns red.
3. u takes the last entry back. g fills the cell you are on when you are stuck. The clock runs from your first entry and pauses while the pane is closed; your fastest time per level is kept.
Keys need the pane focused: click it if nothing happens. h hides this.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
